wait is frustrating. Orders are generally processed within 48 hours, excluding weekends and holidays, and tracking is sent as soon as the package ships.

If an order was placed after 5:00 PM PST on Friday or over the weekend, it would usually be processed the following business day. There can also be occasional delays, and one article notes processing may take about 3 to 4 business days before shipment.

If you log in, I can check your order more closely for you 🙂

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?

03:21 PM

I understand wanting to get it faster. Once an order has been placed, there is not a way to speed up shipping or edit the shipping method.

Orders are processed quickly, so the best option if you need different timing is to place a new order. If your current order is already on its way, you can start a return once it arrives. I know that is not the most convenient option, but I want to set the right expectation kindly 🙂

If it still hasn’t turned up, please wait 2 business days after the posted delivery date before taking further action.
